issues_corrected: basket children no longer extend TRL_MT5_ORDER_INTENT.v1/ORDER_INTENT_FIELDS or call Phase 5 lookup-key functions; six separate basket schemas introduced instead (TRL_BASKET_PLAN.v1, TRL_BASKET_CHILD_INTENT.v1, TRL_BASKET_CHECK_RESULT.v1, TRL_BASKET_CONFIRMATION.v1, TRL_BASKET_CHILD_EXECUTION_RESULT.v1, TRL_BASKET_STATUS.v1)
basket_id and basket_child_id are now fully deterministic with no nonce anywhere in the basket layer

confirmation challenge now exactly derived (sha256("TRL-BASKET-CONFIRM.v1\n"+basket_id+"\n"+canonical_basket_plan_hash)[:16]) with exact CONFIRM-BASKET <16-hex> entry syntax and a defined multi-child-send authorization lifecycle with explicit invalidation conditions

check-freshness rule now references the existing Phase 5 CHECK_FRESHNESS_SECONDS=120 and CONFIRMATION_LIFETIME_SECONDS=300 constants (no new/conflicting duration invented), revalidated at three defined points
send-basket-child <basket_id> <child_id> replaced with argument-free send-basket-next <basket_id>; service alone computes the next eligible child

basket state vocabulary expanded to distinguish REJECTED (governance/schema failure, zero sends) from BLOCKED (SMA/FIB or capability gate, zero sends) from FAILED (first-ever child rejected by broker, zero prior fills) from PARTIALLY_COMPLETED (partial success, one or more prior fills); reconciliation_required redefined as a derived flag, not a competing status
reason-code and event vocabularies deduplicated (e.g. BASKET_CONFIRMATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED replaces ALREADY_CONSUMED; BASKET_CHILD_NOT_NEXT_ELIGIBLE replaces two overlapping sequence-violation codes)
founder_correction_pass.reason_no_change_needed: TRL_PHASE_3_OPERATING_MODE_CONTRACT.md Section 3.1 references R2-009 by section number only (Section 6, Section 13), both of which remain valid after the correction

issues_corrected: confirmation challenge previously derived from only basket_id+canonical_basket_plan_hash (both immutable for a basket's whole lifetime), which would have regenerated the same 'single-use' challenge across two genuinely different confirmation cycles; a new confirmation_basis_hash binds account fingerprint, ordered already-filled child IDs, ordered currently-required check IDs/hashes (new deterministic check_result_id), next eligible child, operating mode, and the CONFIRMATION_LIFETIME_SECONDS value; a deterministic confirmation_request_id derives from basket_id+plan_hash+basis_hash; TRL_BASKET_CONFIRMATION.v1 extended accordingly with a canonical_confirmation_record_hash covering only immutable identity fields

unchanged-basis re-request now reuses the existing active confirmation request/challenge (BASKET_CONFIRMATION_REQUEST_REUSED) instead of silently regenerating an identical one; a changed basis invalidates the prior request and produces a new request ID and challenge (BASKET_CONFIRMATION_BASIS_CHANGED)

stale-check handling after one or more prior fills no longer resets an already-FILLED child; Section 24.2 splits zero-prior-fills staleness from post-fill staleness, permanently preserving every FILLED child's record and returning the basket to CHECK_REQUIRED (never PARTIALLY_COMPLETED, redefined as a permanent-stop-only status) while TRL_BASKET_STATUS.v1 gains filled_child_count/completed_quantity fields for truthful progress reporting

child-state vocabulary corrected to the Founder's exact 11-value list (CREATED, CHECK_REQUIRED, CHECKING, CHECK_PASSED, SEND_RESERVED, FILLED, PARTIALLY_FILLED, REJECTED, FROZEN_PENDING_RECONCILIATION, EXPIRED, BLOCKED); CANCELLED removed (Phase 6 implements no cancellation of any kind) and child-level AWAITING_CONFIRMATION removed (basket confirmation is authoritative, not duplicated per child)

basket-level vocabulary gained an explicit initial CREATED state distinct from CHECK_REQUIRED, plus explicit nonterminal/terminal lists; FROZEN reconfirmed terminal for Phase 6 sending while remaining Phase-10-reconciliation-examinable

reason codes BASKET_JOURNAL_INTEGRITY_UNCERTAIN and BASKET_EXECUTION_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE replace earlier BASKET_LOOKUP_STORE_INTEGRITY_UNCERTAIN/BASKET_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE; new BASKET_RECHECK_REQUIRED and BASKET_CHILD_ALREADY_FILLED added; event names BASKET_PARTIALLY_COMPLETED/BASKET_COMPLETED replace BASKET_PARTIAL_SUCCESS/BASKET_COMPLETE so every event name matches its basket_status value exactly

prior draft's confirmation_basis_hash-only request/challenge derivation let an expired-but-unaccepted request be reissued with the identical confirmation_request_id and challenge_hex (only timestamps replaced), meaning an expired challenge could become valid again on reissue - not approved

confirmation-basis identity (execution-authority snapshot: basket, account, filled-child set, required-check set, next eligible child, mode, confirmation-lifetime policy value) separated from confirmation-cycle identity (new confirmation_cycle_number: durable, monotonic, allocated only at new-record creation under the cross-process lock by scanning journal history for the highest existing cycle for the basket, never reused/decremented/reset; a corrupted/unreadable journal fails closed with BASKET_JOURNAL_INTEGRITY_UNCERTAIN rather than restarting numbering at 1)

confirmation_request_id formula extended to include confirmation_cycle_number + requested_at_utc + expires_at_utc (computed once, at cycle creation, never recomputed); challenge_hex formula extended to include confirmation_request_id itself; both are now unique per cycle, including a same-basis reissue after expiry

TRL_BASKET_CONFIRMATION.v1 gained confirmation_cycle_number and a distinct expired_at_utc field (separate from invalidated_at_utc); canonical_confirmation_record_hash renamed to canonical_confirmation_request_hash, still covering only immutable identity fields

confirm-basket now resolves an entered challenge in exact precedence order: current cycle (proceed to full acceptance checks) -> this basket's own expired prior cycle (BASKET_CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED specifically, per Founder instruction that an old challenge is never accepted merely because a newer cycle exists) -> this basket's own invalidated prior cycle (BASKET_CONFIRMATION_INVALIDATED) -> a different basket's cycle or this basket's already-accepted cycle (BASKET_CONFIRMATION_WRONG_REQUEST, renamed from BASKET_CONFIRMATION_WRONG_BASKET) -> no match (BASKET_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH)

new BASKET_CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED journal event added (distinct from basket-level BASKET_EXPIRED), appended the instant a cycle's expiry is materialized; every BASKET_CONFIRMATION_*/BASKET_RECHECK_REQUIRED event payload now references the affected cycle's confirmation_request_id and confirmation_cycle_number
TRL_BASKET_STATUS.v1 gained active_confirmation_cycle_number alongside the existing active_confirmation_request_id

confirmation_basis_hash previously bound ordered_filled_child_ids/next_eligible_child_id as live values, recomputed and compared at every send; combined with the contract's own claim that one accepted confirmation authorizes the entire sequential send of remaining children, an ordinary successful fill would have caused the send-time equality check (next_eligible_child_id equals the child just computed) to fail for every child past the first - a genuine contradiction found before implementation

confirmation basis redefined as a fixed authorization checkpoint (Section 13.1/13.1.1), computed once at request-basket-confirmation time and never recomputed against live post-acceptance progress: authorized_prior_filled_child_ids (immutable pre-cycle snapshot, normally empty for a first cycle), authorized_remaining_child_ids (complete unsent set this cycle may authorize sequentially - a child stays listed even after it fills), authorized_start_child_id (informational only, not required to track the live next child)
TRL_BASKET_CONFIRMATION.v1 fields ordered_filled_child_ids/next_eligible_child_id renamed to the three authorized_* fields above

Section 13.4.1 rewritten to state explicitly that a child reaching FILLED never by itself invalidates the authorization, creates a new cycle, requires the challenge again, or changes the basis; Section 13.6 gained an explicit 'never invalidates' companion list (fill, live-next-child advancing, completed_quantity/filled_child_count increasing, read-only inspection)

Section 26 send-time gate corrected from exact-equality against a frozen next_eligible_child_id to membership of the live-derived next-eligible child in authorized_remaining_child_ids, with every lower-indexed child either in authorized_prior_filled_child_ids or durably FILLED during the same cycle

confirmation_status vocabulary on TRL_BASKET_STATUS.v1 corrected to drop an inconsistent REJECTED value; a wrong confirm-basket entry is a BASKET_CONFIRMATION_REJECTED attempt-level journal event only, the confirmation record's own status remains REQUESTED afterward (no competing request, no new request-lifecycle status)
TRL_BASKET_STATUS.v1 gained authorized_start_child_id, authorized_remaining_child_ids, a separate live_next_eligible_child_id, remaining_quantity, and terminal_reason
